instruction: Look at guih08_cabinet_panel_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. Launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih08_cabinet_panel_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard cabinet CNC side panel and delete all GUIDE entities before saving. Draw OUTLINE rectangle (0,0)-(1800,700). Add DADO rectangles (80,172)-(1720,188), (80,342)-(1720,358), and (80,512)-(1720,528). Add shelf-pin HOLE circles radius 2 at x=120 and x=1680 for y=90,150,210,270,330,390,450,510,570,630. Add HINGE cup circles radius 17.5 at (60,120), (60,350), and (60,580), plus screw HOLE circles radius 2.5 at y offsets ±32 from each hinge cup. Add labels LEFT SIDE PANEL, 3X DADO 16 WIDE, 20X SHELF PIN Ø4, and 3X HINGE CUP Ø35. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih08_cabinet_panel_completed.dxf.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(10); pyautogui.press("enter")
